instruction: Write JavaScript code that chains promises: fetchUser(id) returns a Promise resolving to {id, postId}, then chain to fetchPosts(postId) logging the title.
Write an async/await function getUser(id) that awaits a fetch call, throws when the response is not ok, and returns the parsed JSON.
Write JavaScript code using Promise.all to fetch three URLs in parallel and log all results together.
Write JavaScript code that uses Promise.allSettled to run three tasks and report how many fulfilled and how many rejected.
Write a JavaScript withTimeout(promise, ms) helper that rejects with an Error if the promise does not settle within ms, using Promise.race.
Write a JavaScript async loop that awaits a promise-producing function sequentially over an array, collecting results in order.
Write a JavaScript promisify(fn) that converts a Node-style callback function (err, result) into one returning a Promise.
Write a JavaScript delay(ms) promise helper and an async function greetAfter(name) that logs a greeting after the delay.
Write JavaScript code that retries an async operation up to 3 times with a 100ms delay between attempts, stopping on success.
Write an async function that uses AbortController to cancel a fetch after 2 seconds and handles the abort error.
Write JavaScript code that awaits Promise.resolve values and a rejected promise inside try/catch, logging the error message.
Write a JavaScript async function parallelLimit(tasks, limit) that runs promise-producing tasks with at most `limit` running at once.
Write an async function main() that chains a thenable then and an await, demonstrating mixed promise styles safely with error handling.
Write JavaScript code where an async function returns a promise and the caller attaches both .then and .catch plus an await in another async function.
Write a JavaScript fetchJson(url, options) wrapper that returns parsed JSON, sets an Accept header, and wraps network failures in a custom Error with a cause.
Write JavaScript code that implements Promise.myAll(promises) behaving like Promise.all, resolving when all settle and rejecting on the first rejection.
Write an async function retryOnNetworkError(fn, attempts) that only retries when the thrown error is a TypeError (fetch network failure).
Write JavaScript code that sequences an async write then async read with await, and runs two independent async tasks concurrently with Promise.all.
Write a JavaScript promisePool(items, workerCount, worker) that processes items with limited concurrency and resolves to an array of results in input order.
Write an async function cachedFetch(url, cache) that stores promise results in a Map so concurrent duplicate calls share one in-flight promise.
